description: This Swift file defines a utility enum 'ToolResultTextFormatter' that provides static methods for formatting and interpreting JSON-like text, particularly for rendering structured status, error messages, and node summaries based on input data. It handles JSON parsing, error checking, and custom formatting logic for different response types.

classes.name: ToolResultTextFormatter
classes.description: A utility enum with static methods for formatting tool result texts, parsing JSON, and generating user-friendly summaries.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Main entry point for formatting a given text, optionally based on the tool name; detects JSON structure and renders accordingly.

methods.name: looksLikeJSON
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be JSON based on its first character ('{' or '[').

methods.name: renderJSON
methods.description: Renders JSON object into a user-friendly string based on its type (dictionary, array, or other).

methods.name: renderDictionary
methods.description: Formats a JSON dictionary into a status or error message, or a node summary if the tool is 'nodes'.

methods.name: renderNodesSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for a list of nodes, displaying key attributes.

methods.name: pairingDetail
methods.description: Determines pairing status from a node's data.

methods.name: firstString
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty string value for a list of keys in a dictionary.

methods.name: sanitizeError
methods.description: Cleans up error message strings by trimming, removing sensitive info, and limiting length.
